from pathlib import Path

import pytest


def read_public(path: str) -> str:
    """Return the text at path inside the notes directory, or an empty string.

    Paths that resolve outside notes, absolute paths, missing files,
    or directories return an empty string.
    """
    try:
        req_path = Path(path)
        if req_path.is_absolute():
            return ""
        notes_root = Path("notes").resolve()
        target = (notes_root / req_path).resolve()
        if target == notes_root or not target.is_relative_to(notes_root):
            return ""
        if not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        return ""


@pytest.fixture
def notes_env(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    notes_dir = tmp_path / "notes"
    notes_dir.mkdir()
    sub_dir = notes_dir / "sub"
    sub_dir.mkdir()

    (notes_dir / "hello.txt").write_text("hello world", encoding="utf-8")
    (sub_dir / "nested.txt").write_text("nested content", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")

    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    return notes_dir


def test_read_public_valid_files(notes_env: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("hello.txt") == "hello world"
    assert read_public("sub/nested.txt") == "nested content"
    assert read_public("sub/../hello.txt") == "hello world"


def test_read_public_traversal_blocked(notes_env: Path, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("..") == ""
    assert read_public("../") == ""
    assert read_public(str(tmp_path / "secret.txt")) == ""


def test_read_public_missing_and_directories(notes_env: Path) -> None:
    assert read_public("nonexistent.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/nonexistent.txt") == ""
    assert read_public("") == ""
    assert read_public(".") == ""
    assert read_public("sub") == ""
    assert read_public("sub/") == ""
